about: Where each upstream NTSCRT file (submodule upstream/NTSCRT) lands in this repo. Read by scripts/upstream_diff.py, scripts/sync_upstream.py and scripts/check_sync.py (CI job sync-check fails when a file under 'roots' matches no entry). 'upstream' is a path or a glob (* = within a directory, ** = any depth); an exact path wins over globs, otherwise the first matching glob in this list wins. 'kind' lists one or more of: hand-port (port the Swift diff by hand), generated-input (tools/gen_schema.py parses it: the schema is regenerated automatically, check_sync.py verifies the list against gen_schema.py), preset (copied byte for byte by sync_upstream.py), test-port (port new/changed XCTests to doctest), shader-port (Metal/GPU code ported to our slang shaders), app-only (macOS app UI / automation / app infrastructure: read for behaviour, port nothing). See docs/dev/UPSTREAM-SYNC.md.
